methods.name: Peer-Median
methods.skip_reason: insufficient narrow peer set in Robotics & Manufacturing (found 0 same-stage, 0 adjacent-stage, 0 similar-tier; need ≥3)
methods.rationale: 11 same-sector peers exist in Robotics & Manufacturing, but none of the narrow filters (same-stage / adjacent-stage / similar-valuation-tier) yielded ≥3 datapoints. Falling back to all-sector median would be misleading.

data.narrative:
Prusa Research is a bootstrapped frontier-tech company operating in the Robotics & Manufacturing sector. The valuation universe comprises 9 comparable companies: 1 public entity (ticker 277810.KQ) and 8 private firms including Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, Generalist AI, and Bedrock Robotics. The limited peer set reflects the nascent and heterogeneous nature of this subsector.

Standard peer-median triangulation cannot be reliably applied here. Of 11 same-sector peers identified, zero meet strict stage-alignment criteria (same-stage or adjacent-stage with similar valuation tier), falling below the minimum threshold of 3 datapoints required for robust median estimation. Attempting an all-sector median would introduce material sectoral heterogeneity and obscure meaningful comparability. Consequently, no quantitative valuation range can be derived from the available comparable data without accepting unacceptable methodological compromise.

This analysis is fundamentally constrained by the absence of sufficiently comparable precedent transactions or current valuations at Prusa Research's stage and business model within the Robotics & Manufacturing sector. Analysts should rely instead on revenue multiples, discounted cash flow analysis, or direct precedent (Series A/B fundraising rounds within the identified peer set) if additional data becomes available. The current dataset supports only the observation that conventional peer triangulation is inapplicable.
